mentions.name: InfoHound
mentions.description: InfoHound is a news platform aggregator that collects sources of information across the internet (social media, newswires, etc.) and pushes context to people in a more digestible form. It also experiments with using AI to define the lineage of information, helping people piece the puzzle together as information flows in.
